author: opencode-worker-8
text: Released without code changes: this is not a single landable slice. Existing lichen_lora_l2_tx hardcodes TX_PRIORITY_BULK, while SOS origin signing needs private-key and routable IPv6 identity state unavailable to puck/UX. Requires decomposition into (1) priority-aware L2 TX API, (2) app identity/key-to-origin signing context, (3) UX SOS event composer/queue integration, and (4) focused tests. No unsigned shortcut is safe.
